notes.title: Massive Update “LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor” (v2.0.0.0) Released!!
notes.content:
[b]※ You cannot match with players using a different network version. Please update to the latest version (v2.0.0.0 displayed at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.[/b]

[p][b]Today, “UNDERWARD” has received a massive update![/b]

The update is titled "UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor"!![/p][previewyoutube=_cmFQl3g-sE;full][/previewyoutube][p]This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is so large in scale that you might think, “Isn’t this practically a new game?”
[/p]
[h1]v2.0.0.0 Update Details[/h1]
[h2]New Mode: “CHAOS”[/h2][p]“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode spanning 6 floors.  
In addition to the abandoned hospital, three new maps have been added—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—each with multiple variations that appear randomly.  
Difficulty levels can also be chosen from “NORMAL,” “HARD,” and “ABYSS,” offering plenty of variety and replayability.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/d5004c19abc6ee278cfb5d581cd12f61632e06e0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/af56672e77d03c417236a385d1539ed87b0cad9f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9409304dba5b79428f97b64273c12c2b951671b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And at the very last floor… could a “Last Boss” be waiting for you!?[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/98d84ed7f425a00b296fb8ce979a3c07bfab3b47.jpg"][/img][/p]
[h2]Gameplay of Both Tension and Laughter[/h2]
[p]This update especially strengthens the B-movie horror panic vibe and the party game elements where everyone can laugh and shout together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/f241c5e17168b6b7b31130cf01278fd619ced259.gif"][/img]
[p]Many new enemies and unique gimmicks have been added, greatly expanding strategies and fun ways to play! (+200% compared to before, in our estimate)  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/80b0bbf03ccc9fe947757cc4cf9b11339486c1a6.gif[/img]
[/p]

[/p]
[h2]Rule Customization Feature Added[/h2]
[p]To make the game enjoyable for a broader audience, we’ve added the ability for players to configure game rules themselves.  
Enjoy casual fun with “Respawn: Unlimited” & “Time Limit: Extended,” or push yourself to extremes with “Enemy Respawn Time: Short” and “Rescue Time: None.”

※ This rules feature can also be applied to the default mode.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/277b43273a14c2c778491dd4a51f1530464a264e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Many Unique Items Added[/h2]
Items have been added!
※ With the addition of these items, the supply machine item pool has been adjusted.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/e5b8ca615d87817c54683e3dc55a5f99239e3049.png[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/2964c05c049bc0b1b6d176a600b3a61fe212dc03.png[/img]  
Discover their effects when you obtain them in-game!

[h2]Other Update Points[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added transport devices “Subject Mover” and “Anti-Gravity Tractor”  
[*] Added new types of Subjects  
[*] Added new uniforms & auras (unlocked by clearing CHAOS mode at each difficulty)  
[*] Added achievements for CHAOS mode  
[*] Added “Return to Lobby” function (host-only from pause menu)  
[*] Added new falling scream voice lines  
[*] Adjusted capture range of certain enemies  
[*] Adjusted some wall collision in existing maps  
[*] Various optimization processes to reduce load  
[*] And more...  
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game fails to launch, showing a memory error  
　→ Please check if your PC meets the minimum specs listed on the store page  
[*] Game performance is poor despite meeting specs and using optimal settings  
　→ [b]Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version[/b] may improve performance. Please try this if possible  
[*] Game may crash under certain conditions (hopefully resolved, but if it persists, please report via the form below)  
　[url=https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9]https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9[/url]  
[*] Desynchronization issues where the game state doesn’t match across players  
　→ This often occurs when the host environment is unstable. If possible, please have the most stable player host  
[*] Crashes when enabling FSR (e.g., when changing quality presets)  
　→ If FSR causes crashes in your environment, please avoid quality presets and adjust settings manually. FSR has been confirmed to work on GPUs listed in the minimum specs, but results may vary by system  
[*] After reconnecting, players carrying capsules may appear to move unnaturally  
[*] Other minor bugs may occur when using the reconnect function  
[/list]

[h1]Future Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes  
[*] Feedback responses  
[/list]

That’s all for now.  
We hope you enjoy the newly added CHAOS mode all the way through to completion.  
Wishing you a great UNDERWARD life!

notes.title: Massive Update Launches for Free on September 24!!
notes.content:
[p][b]On September 24, a massive update is coming to UNDERWARD![/b]

The update is titled: 『UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor』!![/p][previewyoutube=_cmFQl3g-sE;full][/previewyoutube][p]This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is packed with so much content that you might think: “Isn’t this basically a new release?”

[/p][h2]◆ New Mode: “CHAOS”[/h2][p]“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode consisting of 6 floors.  
In addition to the existing abandoned hospital, three new maps with multiple variations—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—will be added, appearing randomly during play.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/d5004c19abc6ee278cfb5d581cd12f61632e06e0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/af56672e77d03c417236a385d1539ed87b0cad9f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9409304dba5b79428f97b64273c12c2b951671b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And at the very last floor… a “final boss” is said to be waiting![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/98d84ed7f425a00b296fb8ce979a3c07bfab3b47.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]◆ A Play Experience of Both Tension and Laughter[/h2][p]This update especially emphasizes the B-movie horror panic vibe, while also adding plenty of party-game-style elements where everyone can laugh and go wild together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/f241c5e17168b6b7b31130cf01278fd619ced259.gif"][/img][/p][p]Many new enemies, quirky funny items, and unique mechanics have been added, making strategies and ways to enjoy the game increase dramatically! (approx. +200% compared to before)

[/p][h2]◆ Rule Customization Feature[/h2][p]To make the game enjoyable for a wider range of players, we’ve added the ability for players to customize game rules.

…However, since it’s such a huge amount of content, we will be adjusting the base game price on Steam after the update. (The DLC price will be lowered so that bundle pricing remains unchanged.)

※ If you don’t yet own the game, buying it before the update will save you some money.

[/p][p][/p][h2]◆ Please Look Forward to the Update![/h2][p]That concludes today’s announcement.[/p][p]A trailer highlighting all the exciting features of the massive update will be released soon—stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Cross-Platform Play Support and More!! (Update v1.2.0.1)
notes.content:
[b]※ You cannot match with players using a different network version. Please update to the latest version (v1.2.0.0 shown at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.[/b]

[h1]Update Details for v1.2.0.1[/h1]

[h2]■ Cross-Platform Play Support[/h2]  
Online play with platforms other than Steam is now supported.  
If you wish to restrict crossplay, you can configure this using the “Crossplay” checkbox on the room search screen.

[h2]■ Player Report & Block Features Added[/h2]  
A new system has been added to report and block malicious players.  
Blocked players will be restricted from using voice chat or joining your room.

[h2]■ Difficulty Adjustments[/h2]  
[list]
[*] Increased the footstep volume of the Bucket Nurse to make it easier to notice her approaching  
[*] Bucket Nurse can now open doors  
[*] Enemies are now less likely to get stuck in front of locked doors  
[/list]

[h2]■ Other Changes[/h2]  
[list]
[*] While carrying a SUBJECT, your character now appears holding the item visibly  
[*] The input match animation during SUBJECT transportation now features a more exciting effect  
[*] Other small fixes and improvements based on feedback  
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]  
[list]
[*] Game fails to launch, showing a memory error  
　→ Please check that your PC meets the minimum system requirements listed on the store page  
[*] Game performance is poor despite meeting specs and using optimal settings  
　→ [b]Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version[/b] may resolve the issue  
[*] Game may crash under specific conditions (we hope this update resolves it, but please report any persisting issues using the form below)  
　[url=https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9]https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9[/url]  
[*] Desynchronization issues (e.g., game state not syncing correctly)  
　→ These issues are more likely to occur when the host’s environment is unstable. Please have the most stable player host, if possible  
[*] Enabling FSR (via quality presets) may cause crashes  
　→ If FSR causes crashes in your environment, please avoid using quality presets and adjust settings manually. FSR has been tested to work with GPUs that meet the minimum requirements, but results may vary  
[*] After reconnecting, players carrying capsules may appear to move unnaturally  
[*] Other minor bugs may occur after using the reconnect feature  
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Updates[/h1]  
[list]
[*] Features to adjust difficulty and game rules  
[*] Additional bug fixes  
[/list]

[h2]Next Major Update[/h2]  
The following features are planned for a future major update (not coming in the near term):  
[list]
[*] New maps and modes with strong randomness and fresh visual styles  
[*] Many new monsters  
[*] Many new items  
[*] Many new traps and mechanics  

※ Sneak peek of the upcoming major update:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/c5140396b3d33a9fbcc2d3c54193008ebe95739e.jpg[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/ca215b5230d16719202acc15923f865c78e9333b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/4c992f2a49e5a792377ce4ac3e7dcabef814df34.png[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/991461b0ab18c0ce201ede0c8aba109db1ccdd4c.png[/img]  
[/list]

That’s all for this update.  
We will continue updating UNDERWARD to provide you with even more fun and engaging content.  
Thank you so much for your continued support!

notes.title: SUBJECT Library, New Monsters & Items, Uniform DLC Now Available! (v1.1.0.2)
notes.content:
[b]※ You cannot match with players using a different version. Please update to the latest version (v1.1.0.2 shown in the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.[/b]

[h1]Update Details for v1.1.0.2[/h1]

[h2]■ SUBJECT Library Feature Added[/h2]
You can now access detailed information, flavor text, retrieval count, and retrieval rate for collected «TEST-SUBJECT» from the title screen after this update.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/147b17aef51d831669a3aab44951005266203010.jpg[/img]

With this addition, the names and point values of undiscovered (unregistered) «TEST-SUBJECT» are now hidden.  
This provides a new thrill of uncertainty—whether you’ve collected enough points—and the joy of discovering the unknown.

※ Whether a SUBJECT’s details are hidden depends on the viewer’s own encyclopedia progress.

[h2]■ Outfit: Aura Equipment Feature Added[/h2]
A new “Aura” customization slot has been added for investigators.  
Separate from the uniform design, players can now equip visual effects that surround the body.  
Some auras unlock based on player rank, while others are available through the new DLC described below.

h2]■DLC [strike]Now Available[/strike] Coming Soon[/h2]
"UNDERWARD - Gorgeous Uniform and Aura for Supporter" and the bundle "UNDERWARD: Supporter Edition" will [strike]be released[/strike] be available soon.

[strike]For more details, please visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3619470/UNDERWARD__Gorgeous_Uniform_and_Aura_for_Supporter/]DLC store page[/url].[/strike]  
[b]※The store page is not yet ready, so this DLC will be available for purchase soon. We apologize for the delay.[/b]


Equip a luxurious “Special Uniform” and an eye-catching “Special Aura” to make your explore even more dramatic.  
Purchasing this DLC is also a great way to support the future development of UNDERWARD and more.
Thanks to your support, we are able to deliver more new content and features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9a95272e5e8fd617ab12ad201583249a9e513fc1.jpg[/img]  
She doesn't detect players by sight, but is extremely sensitive to noise.  
Also, hitting the bucket portion does not deal damage.  
※ "Bucket Nurse" may appear from floor 8 onward.

[h3]Variations Added to Regular Nurse Enemies[/h3]
Several variations with different behaviors and endurance have been added.

[h3]6 New Items Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expansion Bag  
[*] Ceiling Mimic Detector
[*] Adhesive Self‑Censorship
[*] Pink Soft

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/6bd19842f7469756affb1f547b72b38f46a5ba02.png[/img]

Try them out to discover their effects!

Floors 1–12 have had their overall difficulty lowered.  
From floor 13 onward, enemy variation has been increased.  
Additionally, item spawn rates for certain items have been adjusted based on rarity and balance.

More types of random emotes (triggered by the “0” key by default) have been added.  
Use them in combination with the new joke items for even more fun and expressive gameplay.

[h2]■ Achievement System Added[/h2]
You can now earn Steam achievements by meeting various in-game conditions.  
※ If you already met certain conditions before this update, achievements will unlock once you meet a related trigger again.

notes.title: Bug Fix v1.0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]※ Players with different game versions cannot match with each other. Please update to the latest version before playing. (Version number displayed at the bottom left of the title screen: v1.0.3.1) [/b]

[h1] Update Notes for v1.0.3.1 [/h1]

[h2] Fixed an issue where the game would crash on startup for PCs that do not support FSR [/h2]
In the previous update, we changed the upscaling feature (FSR) to be enabled by default to improve performance. However, we received reports that this caused crashes on startup for players using PCs that do not support FSR.

To address this issue, we have applied a fix in update patch v1.0.3.1, which reverts the default setting of FSR to OFF.
If you are experiencing crashes on startup, please check that you have updated to the latest version and try launching the game again.

While this patch should resolve startup crashes, enabling FSR in the options menu (e.g., by changing the Quality Preset settings) may still cause crashes in environments where FSR is not supported.
If your system crashes when using FSR, please avoid using the Quality Preset feature and adjust the settings manually.
(Note: FSR has been confirmed to work correctly with GPUs that meet the minimum system requirements listed on the store page, but performance may vary depending on individual system configurations. We appreciate your understanding.)

That concludes this update.
We will continue working on updates to make the game even more enjoyable, and we truly appreciate your support!

notes.title: Update v1.0.3.0 - New High-Difficulty Deep Levels & Start Floor Selection, Recon
notes.content:
[b]Note: Matching is not possible with different versions. Please update to the latest version (v1.0.3.0 displayed at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.[/b]

---

[h1]Update Details for 1.0.3.0[/h1]

[h2]Major Feature Additions[/h2]

[h3]Reconnection Feature (Experimental)[/h3]
- Players who unexpectedly leave the game can now reconnect from the title screen.
  → Due to strong demand, we have implemented this feature quickly, but since some instability remains, it is currently an experimental function. We appreciate your understanding.
  → If the host disconnects, the room will be disbanded, making reconnection impossible. If possible, please ensure that the host is in a stable network and performance environment.

[h3]Start Floor Selection Added[/h3]
- Hosts can now select specific start floors in the lobby.
  → After this update, reaching certain floors will unlock this feature. (Selectable floors include the standard floors 1-5 and floors after clearing 6, 12, and 18.)
  → Items will not be carried over or supplied when starting from a middle floor.

[h3]Clear Time Display in Results[/h3]
- Allows for casual time-attack play.
  → Time is measured from when the elevator doors open until SUCCESS is displayed.

[h3]More Detailed Graphics Settings[/h3]
- Individual settings for various graphical elements have been added (Quality presets are still available for batch changes).

[h3]Motion Blur ON/OFF Setting Added[/h3]
- Motion blur can now be disabled to prevent motion sickness.

---

[h2]Level Design Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Floors Beyond 13 Become "Sealed Areas"[/h3]
- Difficulty has significantly increased for floors beyond 13 to provide a greater challenge for dedicated players.
  → Enemies appearing in these floors are significantly stronger, with more random placements and spawning patterns.
  → Floor obstacles are also now randomized.
  → The difficulty of starting from floor 13 is extremely high.

*With this update, the floors are categorized as follows:*
- Floors 1-6: "Standard Area"
- Floors 7-12: "Dangerous Area"
- Floors 13-18+: "Sealed Area"

Try clearing up to floor 18, or challenge yourself to see how far you can go!

Other Adjustments:
- Adjusted lighting on floors 7-11.
- Adjusted item placements on floor 4 (difficulty reduction).
- Messages now display upon reaching certain floors.
- "False Hope" placed behind a cage.
- Reports have been added to specific floors and are now easier to find.
- Molotov damage increased from 10 to 12.
- Fixed incorrect damage values in certain language settings.

---

[h2]Minor Fixes[/h2]
- Performance optimizations (memory usage and CPU load improvements).
- Prompts added to suggest options adjustments in case of severe lag.
- Various minor bug fixes and feedback-based improvements.

---

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
- Game fails to launch (due to FSR)
→ The upscaling feature (FSR) was enabled by default to improve performance, but there have been reports that some PCs that do not support FSR cannot launch the game.
→ We will release a patch soon to set FSR to "Off" by default. Please wait for the update.

- Game fails to launch, showing memory shortage errors
  → Please check that your PC meets the minimum specifications listed on the store page.

- Game runs slowly despite meeting specs and optimized settings
  → [b]Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version[/b] may improve performance. Please try this if possible.

- Game crashes under certain conditions
  → If this issue persists despite previous updates, please report it via the form below.
  [url=https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9]https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9[/url]

- Desync issues causing mismatched game states
  → More likely to occur if the host’s network or PC performance is unstable. Please ensure that the host has a stable environment.

- Abnormal movements when reconnecting while carrying a capsule

- Various minor issues related to the reconnection feature

---

[h1]Future Update Plans[/h1]
- Fixing known issues.
- Improvements to item slot management.

*The following are planned for a future major update:*
- New monsters.
- New items.
- Controller support.
- New maps or modes featuring stronger randomization and fresh visual designs.

---

This concludes the update notes. We will continue working on updates to enhance your gaming experience, and we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Solo Play Is Now More Accessible! (Update + Bug Fixes v1.0.2.0)
notes.content:

[*] Added an upscaling (FSR) feature in the GRAPHICS options. Enabling this can improve performance, especially in high-resolution environments.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cardboard mimic monster would sometimes contain no items when opened.

[/list]

[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]

→ Please check if your PC meets the minimum system requirements listed on the store page.

[url=https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9]https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9[/url]

→ Depending on your machine’s specs, lowering the resolution while setting quality to High may provide better performance without impacting gameplay.

→ Enabling the upscaling (FSR) option may significantly improve performance.

[h1]Upcoming Updates[/h1]

notes.title: Bug: Game Crashes Under Specific Conditions and Workaround
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing UNDERWARD.

We have received feedback through reviews and inquiries about the game "force closing" during play, and we would like to provide an explanation and workaround for this issue.

[h1] Workaround [/h1]
This game was developed using UE5 and requires [b]higher system specifications[/b].
Additionally, during multiplayer, the [b]host (room creator) has a heavier load[/b] due to the amount of synchronization required.
[olist]
[*]Check your PC's specs, and if they do not meet the "recommended specs" listed on the store, set the graphics quality to Low in OPTIONS.
[*]If you are using a high-resolution monitor such as a 4K monitor, you can reduce the load significantly by selecting Full Screen or Windowed mode and lowering the resolution.
[*]Do not select unlimited FPS (the lower the FPS, the less the load).
[*](If playing with friends) Ask someone with a high-spec PC to host the game.
[*]Close any other CPU- or GPU-heavy applications, aside from UNDERWARD.
[/olist]
In addition, we are aware of certain crashes related to specific conditions, such as item usage. We are prioritizing and working on fixes for these issues.

Thank you for your understanding and patience. We apologize for the inconvenience and hope the above workarounds help. We will continue to optimize performance and review quality settings in upcoming updates.
